title: Model Fit Compass: triangulating latency-cost-safety signals for vendor prioritization
creator: Rohan Gupta
description:
Short summary: Build a compact, operational 'Model Fit Compass'—a catalog and scoring system that combines latency, token-cost, safety/regulatory flags, and regional availability to prioritize vendor/model choices for product feature owners and procurement.
Goals: 1) provide a reproducible rubric to rank candidate models for a given product workload and region; 2) surface early-warning signals for model supply risk; 3) define procurement trigger thresholds and runbooks.
Scope: APAC/NA/EU regional slices, embeddings vs. chat workloads, and readiness profiles (quantization support, ONNX/Triton packaging). Deliverables include a scored catalog CSV, Grafana dashboard, PRD with procurement triggers, and a lightweight eval harness for latency-cost tradeoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric documented in Confluence with examples for three customer archetypes
Catalog CSV of >=40 candidate model variants with region tags and kernel/quantization compatibility
Grafana dashboard with latency and cost heatmaps for top 10 models in APAC
Procurement trigger matrix with explicit thresholds and associated runbooks
tasks: Compile model inventory and provenance (source, license, packaging)
Instrument synthetic workloads to capture p50/p95 latency and token cost across regions
Add safety/regulatory flags from legal/security checklist
Design and run a 2-week APAC latency probe with internal traffic emulator
Prototype Grafana dashboard and link to Console trace data
Draft PRD for procurement trigger matrix and review with legal and buying team
decisions: Use 3 signal axes for primary ranking: latency (p95), token-cost-per-1000, and safety-risk (binary composite)
Prioritize APAC pilot for procurement triggers due to recent customer churn signals
Adopt normalized z-score aggregation for combining heterogeneous signals into single rank
progress_updates: 2025-01-10 — Ticket created and scope agreed in PM sync; assigned to Sofia Chen
2025-01-15 — Initial model inventory pulled (40 candidates). Identified gaps: ONNX packaging metadata missing for ~12 entries
2025-01-22 — Latency probe harness merged (GH PR #834). Initial APAC samples show 1.8x variance on p95 between regions
2025-01-29 — Cross-functional review with Legal: clarified safety-flagging heuristics and added 'regulatory-uncertain' tag
2025-02-02 — Dashboard prototype live (grafana link). Draft procurement thresholds reviewed by Procurement team; feedback: tighten cost threshold for low-volume customers
next_steps: Bake legal feedback into safety flagging and re-run ranking
Expand latency probes to 3 additional APAC zones and re-score
Finalize procurement trigger matrix and circulate to Sales Ops for approval
Ship catalog CSV to Console data service and add to Model Catalog ingestion pipeline
